$comment: Which commit the binaries people are downloading were built from.
There is no tag for this release and there will not be one: 1.0.0-beta.21 is a
version string that says 'final' and 'not final' in the same breath, and the
decision on 2026-09-07 was to stop making it worse. The next editor release is
1.0.0, tagged v1.0.0, once the quality gates it claims are actually green.
That leaves a shipped binary whose source has to be nameable some other way, so
it is named here, with the evidence, and scripts/ci/repo-truth.mjs checks that
the commit is on the release branch and that the public repository carries it.
artifacts: PDFluent_1.0.0-beta.21_x64_en-US.msi (Authenticode-signed; the Microsoft Store listing serves this installer)
evidence: package.json first reads 1.0.0-beta.21 at 596c911 (2026-07-24 14:03 +0200); the commit after it on the branch is 461fedf (2026-07-24 18:41 +0200).
The universal DMG was written 2026-07-24 14:44, between those two, and its Info.plist reads CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion 1.0.0-beta.21.
461fedf changes five files under store/ and nothing a build reads, so either commit yields the same binary.
